allowlist: caller-supplied store_path only (event-store JSONL, read + append)
filesystem.notes: No fixed allowlist: the caller names the store per call. Any store_path containing '..' is refused fail-closed (path traversal).

execution_personality.sandbox: none (native host execution; deterministic pure-Rust logic, no unsafe, no syscalls beyond std fs)
execution_personality.secret_policy: no secrets handled, read, or emitted

kill_semantics.notes: Kill between two calls loses nothing: every completed op is already sealed in the hash-chained store.
kill_semantics.suspend_means: quiesce; no in-memory state to capture (all state is the file-backed event store), so the default ephemeral checkpoint applies

note: Companion to claim-reconciler.manifest.json: execution personality, resource envelope, and kill semantics per ORGANELLE-MIGRATION-STANDARD v1 (the manifest schema v1 carries only the capability contract).

provenance.build: cargo build -p claim-reconciler (Rust 1.99 stable, workspace Cargo.lock)
provenance.valence_rationale: Logic is pure and deterministic, but the organelle is stateful (file-backed event store) and its verdicts depend on caller-supplied evidence; it cannot certify its own correctness, so Candidate is the honest bound.

resource_envelope.io: sequential append-only JSONL; read_store is O(n) in store size
